issues.description: The problem statement and solution use a class named Meal (including UML and examples) but the template repository contains an Order class with the Meal-like structure while the template's Meal.java is empty. This identifier mismatch (Order vs Meal) will confuse students: they may implement or look for Meal methods/constructors in the template but only find Order, causing mapping confusion and extra, unnecessary friction.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the problem statement by providing a Meal class in the template (populate src/de/tum/cit/ase/Meal.java with the same structure as the solution) and remove or rename Order.java to Meal.java, or update the problem and solution to consistently use Order instead of Meal. Also ensure Main and other template code references Meal (not Order).
